title: ACDSDATA preservation lifecycle and modern BODY profile readiness
mode: Primary-source release, pull-request, repository, official format documentation, local specification, and local implementation review
scope: Review current open-source ACDSDATA preservation behavior for lifecycle cases that affect serialization readiness.
Separate legacy BODY DXF group-1/3 payload from modern AcDs/SAB record association.
Define a bounded decision path for modern BODY without blocking unrelated implementation or promoting unsupported claims.

local_checks: Read-only inspection of the AC1027 DXF writer qualification predicate and nearby dispatch.
Cross-reference against existing generated ACDSDATA owner, multi-record, block/INSERT, payload, and transactional-refusal coverage.
Reviewed local authoritative ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 passages §§20.4.41, 20.4.1, and 24.2.2.3.
method.limitations: CADCraft PR behavior and its real-file byte-preservation statement were not independently reproduced. The reviewed ODA passages establish modern AcDs/SAB details for REGION/3DSOLID but do not establish the modern BODY owner/key mapping. No modern BODY profile is qualified by this research.

sources.name: CADCraft merged ACDSDATA lifecycle change
sources.observed: PR #781 merged on 2026-10-13 and is listed in v0.7.0. Its description reports retaining ACDSDATA through save, filtering records for entities no longer emitted, omitting the section for pre-2013 output or when no associated owner remains, version-aware loss reporting, and byte-identical SAB for 627 bodies in a real drawing. The current lockfile pins ACadRust 0.6.4.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Useful application-level lifecycle design and contributor-reported preservation result only. Not normative record-schema evidence, independently reproduced runtime behavior, B-rep semantic evidence, or an independent DWG parser lineage.

sources.name: Autodesk BODY DXF reference
sources.observed: The BODY entity uses AcDbModelerGeometry, modeler format version, proprietary group-1 data, and optional group-3 continuation lines.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Legacy DXF entity grammar only; it does not specify the modern AcDs section association.

sources.name: Local ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sources.observed: Reviewed §§20.4.41, 20.4.1, and 24.2.2.3 for modeler and AcDs carrier details. These passages cover the relevant modern AcDs/SAB route for REGION/3DSOLID but do not resolve the corresponding BODY owner/key mapping.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Authoritative local byte-layout source; absence of a BODY rule in the reviewed passages is not proof that no other specification passage or real profile defines one.

sources.name: Local AC1027 DXF writer guard
sources.observed: hasQualifiedAc1027AcdsRecord accepts DRW::E3DSOLID and DRW::REGION, then validates source version/modeler profile, SAB signature, owner handle/key, and a unique AC1027 ACDSDATA section. BODY is excluded from that qualified route and the writer fails closed.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Current local implementation boundary only; does not establish normative format support or a defect.

sources.name: obj2cad source-generated ACIS carrier candidate
sources.observed: The pre-release project advertises a custom SAT/SAB writer and analytic primitive samples; it labels DXF verified and DWG/curved surfaces beta pending AutoCAD acceptance. Its documented readback routes are ezdxf and ACadRust.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Optional from-scratch carrier producer only; no independent semantic or kernel proof, no BODY AcDs join evidence, and no runtime executed here.

sources.name: LibreDWG current AcDs reader path, release notes, and issue
sources.observed: Current source contains an R2013+ AcDsPrototype_1b reader path. NEWS still calls the store incomplete and describes brute-force SAB extraction; issue #1411 is scoped to a reported release/build and REGION SAB loss.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Section-reader investigation lead only; does not establish complete BODY record association or semantic solid validity.

plan_impact.cadcraft_lifecycle: Use retained-owner, deleted-owner, no-owner, and target-version downgrade as lifecycle cases under the existing ACDSDATA carrier owner. Treat CADCraft as same-ACadRust-lineage application evidence, not an independent DWG vote.
plan_impact.body_profile: Keep legacy BODY group-1/3 handling separate. Modern BODY remains NOT_QUALIFIED / PROFILE_DISCOVERY_PENDING until exact ODA text or a traceable, locally generated, independently interpreted profile defines the section/key/owner mapping. Preserve current transactional refusal and do not coerce BODY into REGION/3DSOLID.
plan_impact.implementation_readiness: If a modern BODY route becomes qualified, test only the missing delta with a local in-memory or from-scratch vector: exact payload, owner-key closure, duplicate/missing/orphan handling, applicable ASCII/Binary behavior, target downgrade, and transactional destination preservation. Reuse existing ACDSDATA multi-record and block/INSERT tests for shared invariants.
plan_impact.speed_and_unblocking: Use source/spec preflight first. If the mapping remains unspecified, record the profile boundary and continue unrelated local implementation. Keep strict focused tests per code slice and full/platform/native suites at the scheduled composed checkpoint; external samples and peer runtimes are not prerequisites.
plan_impact.obj2cad: Optional composed-checkpoint source-generated carrier candidate only, pinned to an immutable revision and checked against a separate analytic manifest. No dependency, committed generated fixture, or semantic support promotion.
plan_impact.implementation_change: No local defect reproduced; no code/test, new finding, top-level subplan, fixture, dependency, peer/native execution, full-suite run, validation-cadence change, or support claim added.

repository_state: Plan and research receipt only in a broadly dirty shared worktree. This pass did not stage or commit any files.
